experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1 and 9.8 on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT): seven outer words from the seed, the test of the work register W against WB; the 39 context lines once and the descriptor table of the masked partner walk; clusters of 32 members (e1 bits 10-14); representative batches 0 to 3 and the last, 32 clusters; per representative the key and the exact-borrow gate table, no T2 lookup on a closed gate; per opened cluster its units added to W, the representative's test (2) and paths, the byte guard, then five partner batches or the descriptor's two chunks; test (2) on T2' at word 0; the E lane with its addition to W; at a batch's first E lane the packed Y9 path, cached; T1 at word 2^34 on the cached Y9; a passing lane with its addition to W, the shortcut, the pre-check of 9.7 and the preflight of the metered cap CM(T); the metered debit of the executed work; the joint solver of 9.4 with (G7) and (G15) on the source bank and the root predicate; for the first certified root, both last-chunk compressions at counter t and the 256-bit test. Table entries are computed on demand. In the same run every walked member is recomputed straight-line and its omega mod 512 tested against its cluster's two exact prefixes, closed clusters and left-out partners are tested bit by bit for (2), gate keys and descriptors against scalar words, T2 entries used bit by bit, every cached Y9 is checked against a fresh fill, every passing lane's words, pre-check and bank against a scalar rebuild and every metered debit against the ledger, every solver call is repeated without G15 with real-compression certificates, every E lane's step-CT message is compressed, and every 8th trial plants a joint root that both traversals must return. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, the c1 forcing t = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits. This is exact: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: members (walked), e_lanes (test-(2) passes), passes, solver_calls, leaves, roots, certified, units (charged machine units), solver_units (the solver ledger by nodes), opened and closed (clusters), skipped_pass (members of closed clusters or partners left out that pass (2) bit by bit), checks, mismatches (a solver call above its cap, a metered debit that differs from the ledger, a guard word, bank word or cache entry that differs counts as one), fills (batches whose packed Y9 was built, one per batch with an E lane) and halted. Expected per trial: 32 clusters, about 41% opened (proved bound 0.4117), about 140 walked members, 53 E lanes in 13 filled batches and 0.9 passes, about 0.28 solver calls per pass, almost always no root; skipped_pass, mismatches and halted 0. In the participant's local run of this request: 3,353 of 8,192 clusters opened, 35,834 members walked, 13,481 E lanes, 3,378 fills, 225 passes, 64 solver calls, no root, 379,207 checks, 0 skipped passes, 0 mismatches. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
